description: Governed data replication provider evaluated behind the VAOS Automation & Integration Fabric.

licensing.model: Open-source/self-managed or managed service; connector licensing, data-residency and commercial terms require qualification.
licensing.notes: VAOS invokes only pre-approved connection keys mapped to Airbyte connection IDs.

notes: Production qualification remains blocked until connection-level data classification, source/destination ownership, short-lived token acquisition, busy/rate-limit behavior, status reconciliation, cancellation, schema-change policy and data-residency controls are evidenced.
